ValidationRule.description: Reseller decides the Exact administration: only System Administrators and cp_AllowFinancialEntityChange (ps_miAllowFinancialEntityChange) may change it; integration users not exempt. Filling a blank reseller is allowed.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You are not allowed to change the Customer Entity (Reseller): it decides the Exact administration. Ask a user with permission set miAllowFinancialEntityChange.
